name: The Tome of Valor
summary: At Daphne Stilwell's farm in Westfall, a paladin faces a trial of valor. The Defias Brotherhood is pressing the homestead, and Daphne needs a defender at her side.

sections.title: A Stand in the Dust
sections.body: Daphne Stilwell's homestead in Westfall lies in land contested by the Defias Brotherhood. While seeking the virtues recorded in the Tome of Valor, you are sent to defend her farm. The Defias have tried repeatedly to overrun the property and kill Daphne. After earlier clashes, another attack is expected. You must stand beside her house instead of retreating to safer ground.

sections.title: The Trial of Valor
sections.body: Daphne and you face wave after wave of Defias raiders. She has only her personal firearm, while you have the blessings of the Holy Light. The fight tests whether you can protect someone vulnerable under heavy pressure. True valor is not the pursuit of personal glory, but the willingness to stand between innocent civilians and ruthless violence.

faq.answer: Daphne Stilwell is a human homesteader who lives in Westfall's grasslands. Though the Defias Brotherhood regularly intrudes on her land, she refuses to leave and fights back against their raids.

faq.q: Why are the Defias attacking this specific farm?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has taken much of Westfall's countryside, driving farmers away or forcing them to submit. Daphne's husband, Jordan, is away in Ironforge, leaving her alone and unprotected, and the Defias want her land.

faq.q: What is the Tome of Valor?
faq.answer: The Tome of Valor is a sacred text the Church of the Holy Light uses to guide young paladins. Knights-in-training face physical and spiritual trials across the kingdom to live by its virtues.

faq.q: What happens if Daphne falls during the battle?
faq.answer: If Daphne Stilwell falls in battle, the trial fails. Valor calls for protecting her life as well as your own from the bandit attack.

faq.q: Where does this attack take place?
faq.answer: The attack takes place outside Daphne Stilwell's farmhouse, a small farm in the Dagger Hills overlooking the Longshore in southern Westfall.

faq.q: What comes after defending the farm?
faq.answer: After you prove your courage and drive off the Defias raiders, Daphne acknowledges your devotion and directs you toward the next phase of your paladin trials.

angles.text: As a paladin, you are tested as a steadfast protector. Holding the line beside Daphne shows valor in action: shielding the innocent from harm.
Stormwind's garrison is spread thin and cannot guard rural homesteads. Defending Westfall's loyal citizens falls to individual heroes.
